newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ticor sees improved second half results.
newsitem.headline: Ticor sees improved second half results.

text.p: Titanium producer Ticor Ltd said on Tuesday it expected improved results in the six months ending December 31, 1997 following its A$4.39 million loss in the six months to June.
"Cost reduction strategies previously implemented are continuing and directors expect improved results in the second half year," Ticor said in a statement accompanying its half year results.
The result represented a narrowing from the A$9.99 million loss a year earlier. It said it expected a positive contribution from all its energy businesses for the rest of 1997.
Ticor said second half results from its chemical division could be affected by competition and lower demand resulting from falling gold prices.

It said results from its resource division were adversely impacted by industrial disputes in the Western Australia power industry effecting all operations and also interrupted deliveries from a major supplier to the pigment plant.
